name: Holy Avenger
summary: A +3 weapon that deals extra Radiant damage to Fiends and Undead and projects a protective aura.

stats.effect:
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from you. You and all creatures {ref:glossary/friendly} to you in the Emanation have {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If you have 17 or more levels in the {ref:class/paladin} class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.
